theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)), MeasurableSet M → CountablyRectifiable n M → ∃ (F : ℕ → Euclid n → Euclid P) (B : ℕ → Set (Euclid n)) (m : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ i, ∃ L : NNReal, LipschitzWith L (F i)) ∧ (∀ i, MeasurableSet (B i)) ∧ (∀ i, 0 < m i) ∧ (∀ i, ∀ a ∈ B i, ∀ a' ∈ B i, m i * ‖a - a'‖ ≤ ‖F i a - F i a'‖) ∧ (∀ i, ∀ a ∈ B i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (F i) a ∧ Injective (fderiv ℝ (F i) a)) ∧ (∀ i, MeasurableSet (F i '' B i)) ∧ (∀ i, F i '' B i ⊆ M) ∧ Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (F i '' B i) (F j '' B j)) ∧ μHE[n] (M \ ⋃ i, F i '' B i) = 0) → (∀ (P n : ℕ), (∀ (α : Covector (Euclid P) n) (v : Fin n → Euclid P), |α v| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α * Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j => inner ℝ (v i) (v j)))) ∧ ∀ τ : Fin n → Euclid P, Orthonormal ℝ τ → ∃ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, covectorEuclideanNorm α ≤ 1 ∧ α τ = 1) → ((∀ (P n : ℕ) (U M M' : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet M → MeasurableSet M' → M ⊆ M' → M' ⊆ U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (M' ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict M), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M' x Q) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (E : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet E → ∃ (A : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R' : IMRep U n), R'.Represents A ∧ R'.carrier = R.carrier ∩ E ∧ R'.mult = R.mult ∧ R'.orient = R.orient) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (A B : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → IsIntegerMultiplicity A → IsIntegerMultiplicity B → IsIntegerMultiplicity (A - B)) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n), ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict R.carrier), ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, |R.orient x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α)) → ∀ (P n : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), R.measure univ ≠ ∞ → ∃ (G : ℕ → Euclid n → Euclid P) (A : ℕ → Set (Euclid n)) (w : ℕ → Euclid n → ℤ) (c : ℕ → Euclid n → ℝ), (∀ i, ∃ L : NNReal, LipschitzWith L (G i)) ∧ (∀ i, MeasurableSet (A i)) ∧ (∀ i, Measurable (w i)) ∧ (∀ i, Measurable (c i)) ∧ (∀ i, ∀ u ∈ A i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (G i) u) ∧ (∀ i, G i '' A i ⊆ R.carrier) ∧ (∀ i, IntegrableOn (fun u => (w i u : ℝ)) (A i)) ∧ (∀ i, ∀ u ∈ A i, 0 ≤ c i u ∧ ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, |α (fun a => fderiv ℝ (G i) u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1))| ≤ c i u * covectorEuclideanNorm α) ∧ ∑' i, ∫⁻ u in A i, ENNReal.ofReal (|(w i u : ℝ)| * c i u) ≤ R.measure univ ∧ ∀ η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n, Continuous η → HasCompactSupport η → HasSum (fun i => ∫ u in A i, (w i u : ℝ) * η (G i u) (fun a => fderiv ℝ (G i) u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1))) (R.action η)
